item.description: Good morning Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and welcome back to your Daily Drive. We've got a gorgeous autumn day ahead, perfect for your commute, and a long weekend on the horizon thanks to the Labour Day public holiday on Monday! Did you know that the "Rule of Three" suggests things are more effective in sets of three? So let's make today, Friday, a triple threat of productivity, positivity, and pure joy! Let's get this fantastic long weekend started!
